dct_description_sm:
This dataset contains the boundaries of the City's protected views. Development within the polygons is limited in height to maintain these public views.

Note: To understand view cone implications on individual sites, please email views@vancouver.ca

Data currency

The extract for this dataset is updated as needed. There may be no change in data content from one week to the next because there is no change in source data. Priorities and resources will also determine how fast a change in reality is reflected in the database. 

Data accuracy

These view corridors have been entered accurately, but the authoritative source for these is the City's bylaws.
